The list's paper texture is noise in the screenshot and a flat mean colour in the example, so the threshold stays at the default.

comparisons.name: keyboard-light
comparisons.description: Tab to the divider and press Right Arrow twice: the pane grows by 10 pt per press to 60 pt, and the focused divider shows the focus ring. Aqua. No screenshot shows a focused divider (inferred).

pixels.note: the first pane now covers 50 pt
divider moved from 40 to 60 pt (two 10 pt steps); measured colour
3 pt focus ring over the window background: measured on the Go to Folder field (spec: focus-ring)
window background beyond the ring

comparisons.name: keyboard-limits-dark
comparisons.description: Tab to the divider and press End, then Left Arrow: End takes the pane to its 70 pt maximum and one step back gives 60 pt. Dark Aqua.

pixels.note: first pane (control background) now covers 50 pt
dark divider is black, measured (spec: split-view)
second pane: window background

comparisons.name: not-key-light
comparisons.description: The same keyboard input in an inactive window: the divider still moves, without a focus ring (inferred, as for every control in a window that is not key).

pixels.note: divider at 50 pt after one step; measured colour
no focus ring beside it in a window that is not key
